cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: Choose Me
cards.instruction: Make yourself the choice over another person, plan, or obligation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No need to put me in charge. Take me as your expedition photographer instead of Martin. I speak French.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're crossing a desert, not interviewing people.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm merely helping this reach the right outcome. Your sponsor's French. I could send them updates they can actually use.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They want their logo visible in every picture.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll put it on the water flask. Martin photographs untouched wilderness; I'll make sure yours looks generously funded.

mechanism: A offers itself as a modest camera carrier while deciding the sponsor-facing expedition imagery, using control of those choices to win selection over Martin.
confusable: Not merely boasting of a skill: A sets concrete communications and image policy while minimizing its status.
comparison: Birthday inclusion versus expedition appointment through funding needs.
